name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy, Roasted New Potatoes & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg new potatoes
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes and place on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp basil, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; peel and thinly slice onions. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms, add to the bowl with the garlic and onion, and set aside.

Place beef, eggs, bread crumbs, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices in another medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip and pan-fry until cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet) and cover with aluminum foil.

While the patties are cooking, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to another baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add baking sheet to the oven and roast broccoli until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and mushrooms; cook, stirring often, until softened, 6-7 minutes.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Add broth and Worcestershire, stir to combine, and bring the gravy to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Return patties to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the gravy has thickened and patties are warmed through, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide potatoes, broccoli, and beef patties between plates. Top patties with mushroom gravy and enjoy!
